criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: OSM way 231217849 identifies Crosswalk Commons at 925 Hilltop Drive; its 14-vertex WGS84 ring is retained by the mesh with independently measured maximum vertex-to-ground-vertex error 0.000037 m.
criteria.finding: Strong identity/plan evidence, with the limitation that OSM is crowd-sourced rather than survey control.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The source ring is transformed with the repository local conversion and matches the saved mesh vertices. Reopened Blender bounds are [65.6197509765625, 28.06951904296875, 9.5] m, consistent with the source-derived outline.
criteria.finding: Horizontal placement and outline are source-backed; the project conversion and mapped footprint carry stated uncertainty.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: Official 2023 operator gallery photos visibly support three levels and a low, nearly flat parapet. The reopened asset is 9.5 m tall. No dimensioned elevation or measured roof-height source is provided; the model evidence labels 9.5 m as an estimate.
criteria.finding: Floor count and general roof silhouette are plausible from photographs, but vertical scale remains estimated and rooftop form is not documented.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Official operator photos show pale horizontal siding above a ground-level dark fascia, red-brick piers, large common-area glazing, and a substantial stone entry wall/canopy. The candidate has pale upper wall zones and repeated windows, but the ground facade reads mostly as repeated blue windows with sparse narrow brick accents; the distinctive stone wall, broad dark glazing/fascia composition and actual entrance position are not reproduced or geolocated.
criteria.finding: Facade material vocabulary is partly present, but characteristic ground-floor composition and entrance mass need evidence-led revision; no source supports the chosen entrance side.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Independently reopened in Blender 4.5.15: expected scene/collection, one mesh named Crosswalk Commons, seven material slots, no modifiers or external image dependencies. Four operator exterior stills, raw OSM response, source notes, and explicit uncertainty records are saved.
criteria.finding: Portable single-mesh export and source evidence are complete for the claims made.

identity_and_footprint_source.measurement_method: Closed 14-vertex OSM building outline; vertices transformed into the project's local approximate campus XY coordinates using the documented meters conversion.
identity_and_footprint_source.uncertainty: Mapped crowd-sourced footprint, not a survey; local project conversion is approximate. Supports horizontal outline and identity, not vertical geometry or facade details.

visual_source.provider: Crosswalk Project, Inc. / Crosswalk Commons official image gallery
visual_source.source_date: Gallery copyright 2023; individual photo dates unknown
visual_source.measurement_method: Visual inspection for apparent storeys, roof silhouette, broad material zones, entry mass, glazing and window rhythm.
visual_source.uncertainty: Photographs are perspective views and are not dimensioned elevations; precise dimensions and facade orientation/entry geolocation are unverified.

assumptions.floor_count: Three visible levels interpreted from official operator exterior photographs; estimated, not independently documented in an elevation drawing.
assumptions.height_status: Estimated from three visible levels, not a measured elevation.
assumptions.roof: Simple flat roof/parapet; rooftop plant and fine roof geometry not visible in available imagery.
assumptions.entrance: Stone portal and dark canopy included; exact side and location are not georeferenced and remain approximate.
assumptions.facade: Broad siding, brick, stone, dark fascia, and glazed areas follow official gallery photographs; detailed dimensions and orientation remain unverified.
assumptions.placement: Keeps the source OSM ring in the repository campus coordinate frame; no campus relocation made.

evidence.independent_inspection: Reopened the current saved .blend in Blender 4.5.15 and inspected the two saved rendered views against the retained official operator photographs.

findings: Revise the ground-floor long facade from repeated generic storefront windows to match the operator photograph: broad glazed common-area bays separated by brick piers, continuous dark fascia, and the larger stone entry wall/canopy.
Locate the entrance on a georeferenced or clearly identifiable photograph/map view before treating its side and position as verified; current longest-edge placement is expressly approximate.
Keep 9.5 m roof height labeled estimated unless dimensioned elevation or reliable height data is obtained.
